title: refactor(ci): unify lint/test/release workflows + deps hygiene
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary: Consolidates multiple GitHub Actions workflows into reusable composites to reduce duplication, improve cache effectiveness, and standardize lint/test/release steps across the monorepo. Also bumps a set of GH Actions and node versions, fixes a flaky Windows build step, and applies repo hygiene (remove deprecated workflows, update docs). Motivation: CI runtime and maintenance cost has grown due to duplicated jobs across repositories and inconsistent job configs. This PR centralizes common concerns and improves throughput + cache hit rates.

What changed: - Introduced .github/workflows/reusable/lint.yml, reusable/test.yml and reusable/release.yml composite workflows used by package and repo-level workflows. - Consolidated per-repo lint/test orchestrators into a single .github/workflows/{lint,test}.yml that calls the composites. - Upgraded Node.js runner matrix default to 20 and normalized OS matrix coverage (ubuntu-latest, macos-latest). - Bumped frequently-used actions to recommended stable tags (actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, actions/cache@v4, softprops/action-gh-release@v2 -> gh-release maintained fork). - Improved cache keys (use workspace+package-lock hash) and add restore-keys to reduce cold-cache misses. - Fixed Windows build flake by ensuring CI_NODE_OPTIONS environment variable is set in the win build job and made yarn install deterministic with npm ci fallback. - Removed legacy release script that called an internal tool and replaced with the new consolidated release composite that supports dry-run canaries and per-package changelog extraction.

Testing and validation performed: - Ran the new workflows on this branch (head) against a subset of packages via a workflow_dispatch matrix. - Verified lint and unit test stages across Node 18 and 20 locally and in GitHub Actions; Node 20 is the new default for job matrices. - Observed ~18% reduction in end-to-end CI wall time on a cached run due to reduced duplication and better cache reuse. - Manually triggered release composite dry-run and validated changelog generation and tag creation steps in sandboxed repo.

Notes: - Consumers of the workflows should not need to change job-level configs unless they were relying on an undocumented environment variable. - This is primarily a maintenance/infra change; no production code changes. See release_notes for highlights.
commits:
* 8c9f2d1 - chore(ci): introduce reusable lint/test/release composites
* e3a7b5f - chore(ci): consolidate top-level workflows to call composites and normalize matrices
* b4d7e90 - fix(ci): address windows build flake (set CI_NODE_OPTIONS) + cache key tweaks
review_comments:
Diego Martinez (reviewer): Looks great overall — reusable composites are much cleaner. Two small asks: 1) clarify the restore-key pattern in test.yml, 2) add a comment about why Node 20 is default.
Aisha Patel (author): addressed both; added comments and examples for restore-key and added a note to docs/ci/README.md explaining Node 20 migration path.
Ruth Chen (reviewer): Please ensure the release composite still supports token passthrough for org-owned repos; also run a dry-run in sandbox first.
Aisha: validated dry-run in sandbox and added PAT passthrough support with minimal perms.
Omar Haddad (approver): Approved after CI rerun stabilized.
ci_checks_summary: Initial CI run: some flaky failures on windows job (node-gyp build step). After fix (b4d7e90) rerun passed. Checks: lint (passed), unit-tests (passed), integration-smoke (passed), release-dry-run (passed), e2e-checks (passed). Total runs: 3 (1 failing, 2 passing).
merge_outcome: Merged to main via squash on 2026-02-22 after approvals from Diego Martinez and Omar Haddad. No conflicts. Post-merge: removed two legacy workflow files (.github/workflows/old-release.yml, .github/workflows/ci-legacy.yml) in a follow-up commit to keep history tidy.
release_notes:
- Consolidated CI workflows into reusable composites: lint/test/release
- Default Node.js runner bumped to 20 (normalize matrices)
- Bumped GH Actions to v4 where applicable; improved cache keys and restore-keys
- Fixed Windows build flake (CI_NODE_OPTIONS)
- Reduced CI wall-time by ~18% in cached runs
notes: Follow-up: monitor first two weekly runs for cache hit regression and watch release automation for tags in downstream repos. Ops to watch: action-version drift and GH Actions runner image updates.
